title: pilosella fallacina subsp. alsatica
intro: Pilosella fallacina subsp. alsatica, commonly known as Alsaticy corydalis or Alsaticy buttercup, is a plant species in the dandelion genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella fallacina subsp. alsatica include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antitumor activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and the mechanisms by which it exerts its effects.
